s1.syndrome_frame: A tender, enlarging scalp lesion with a duration of 6 months, characterized by a bright pink, dome-shaped papule with overlying vessels
salient_findings: Bright pink, dome-shaped papule with overlying vessels
Concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells around small vessels
key_facts: 74-year-old man
History of multiple squamous cell carcinomas
Treated with Mohs micrographic surgery
6-month duration of the scalp lesion
5-mm bright pink, dome-shaped papule
Overlying vessels present
No purulent discharge or overlying skin changes
Hematoxylin-eosin staining demonstrated concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells
Tumor cells are hyperchromatic and variable in nuclear size
Scattered mitoses and necrosis present
Smooth muscle actin (SMA) was diffusely positive in the tumor cells
CD31 immunostain highlighted many endothelial-lined vascular channels

shortlist.label: Angiosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Bright pink, dome-shaped papule with overlying vessels and positive CD31 immunostain

shortlist.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
shortlist.why_kept: Dome-shaped papule and history of multiple squamous cell carcinomas

shortlist.label: Pleomorphic dermal sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Hyperchromatic and variable nuclear size of tumor cells, scattered mitoses and necrosis

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse positivity for smooth muscle actin (SMA) in tumor cells

shortlist.label: Glomus tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of overlying vessels and positive smooth muscle actin (SMA) staining

raw.rationale: The presence of overlying vessels, concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells around small vessels, and diffuse positivity for smooth muscle actin (SMA) and CD31 immunostain highlighting endothelial-lined vascular channels support the diagnosis of Angiosarcoma.

rejected.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
rejected.why: Typically shows a storiform or cartwheel pattern and is usually CD34 positive, which is not mentioned in the case

rejected.label: Pleomorphic dermal sarcoma
rejected.why: Lacks the specific vascular features and immunohistochemical profile seen in this case

rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: Would typically show more pronounced smooth muscle differentiation and positivity for markers like desmin, which is negative in this case

rejected.label: Glomus tumor
rejected.why: Usually has a more distinctive glomoid appearance with cuboidal cells surrounding vascular lumens and is typically positive for smooth muscle markers like SMA, but also usually has a more uniform appearance and lacks the significant atypia and mitoses seen in this case
